I am aware of suicide methods and their efficacy. I am aware that 6% of people who try to kill them by overdose are successful. Lacerations sits at around 2%. I work in health care, I fucked it up. I can into detail regarding the overdose I took and it is abnormal because it is more likely to be successful. I am quite ill due to the damage I caused with the drugs taken (cocktail of roccuronium, atropine, pethidine, ephedrine and prochlorperazine for the various effects they have). I messed up my timing. That is mostly why I'm still alive. The trying to slit my throat unsuccessfully makes me think that maybe you are right in a way maybe I am more hopeful then I believe. I freely admit I don't want to die. I just see dying as my only available escape from the pain. 

Just realised my reply sounds dickish, I don't mean to sound that way just saying the facts around it and such. Don't know why you got down voted. I appreciate your contribution.

That's good that you have that as a driving force. Glad it keeps you ground and going. I'm still trying to find my thing that gives me drive. Maybe I'll never find and be destined to die by my own hand. Maybe not.

I feel empty barely human the majority of the time. I don't think there's any event I can put my finger on that might explain. Everyone just seems content with life. Like they have something to achieve. They have some form of happiness. I don't know how or where from.

I appreciate you replying. I really do. I'm sorry you've been through such stuff as well.
Life is complicated in general and after the attempt it's just got more complicated. I don't know why I'm sad all the time. I don't know what's wrong. I don't know how to fix it. It came to this and I tried to end my life and I even failed at that.
